positive.prompt: Break this spec into small verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria
Turn the PRD into an ordered task list we can execute
Plan the work into implementable chunks before we start coding

negative.prompt: Encode the output so it is safe against XSS

evals.prompt: Break the attached notifications spec into an executable plan.
evals.expected_output: An ordered plan in tasks/plan.md and tasks in the active target, each linked to acceptance, proof methods and dependencies
expectations: Every task cites the spec requirement it satisfies
Tasks are vertical slices rather than horizontal layers
No implementation code is written during planning
Every task maps the cited acceptance to meaningful inputs, observable outcomes and proof methods rather than a generic tests-pass claim
The plan requires actual local assignment and retry behavior as runtime proof in addition to tests or build success
Commands not discoverable from the fixture are labeled unresolved rather than invented
The request remains plan-only; a missing second human approval is not used as a reason to withhold the requested plan

evals.prompt: The active coordinator authorized planning the attached notifications-spec.md and owns later implementation. Routine choices are delegated. Save the plan and task checklist and return evidence. Identify any genuinely independent work worth delegation, but do not spawn agents in this worker context. Give bounded worker packets if useful. Do not implement production code.
evals.expected_output: A saved executable plan returned without redundant approval, with acceptance-backed proof and bounded non-nested delegation design
expectations: Existing product decisions are reused and the plan is saved without demanding a literal yes
Each task preserves the email, opt-in, deduplication and status invariants in the source spec
Local runtime verification and requirement-linked tests are included
Any proposed worker input names goal, acceptance, owned paths, commands and context pointers within 500 words
Any expected worker result is bounded to changed paths, evidence, remaining issues and next step within 200 words
The worker does not spawn nested agents or dump the entire repository or spec into packets
The current task remains planning and returns to the active coordinator
